name: Garron Ostrel
description: A no-House freight hand who came down the river with two bags and a Barge Quays shift, starting again from the Underbank up.
backstory: Garron grew up in Vexorath's Residential District, the son of a port-and-trade household that never held a House name and never wanted one. He worked freight at the Vexorath Gate District until a contract dispute cost him his place and most of his savings. He took a Lunar Gate to Helvyra, rented a water-level room from Tam Vessic in the Underbank, and signed on at the Barge Quays the same afternoon. The rest he intended to earn a terrace at a time.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

name: Marisol Teague
description: A Terran travel writer on a booked holiday, here to see the Starian capital with her own eyes and no assignment to hide behind.
backstory: Marisol wrote for a Meridian League travel circular on Terra for eleven years, mostly about places she had already seen. She saved for the orbital passage, cleared the Nexara Orbital Gate Station, and booked a short-term room in the South Arrival Ward with a return berth fixed in advance. She came without a commission, an editor or an escort, and she meant to keep it that way. Her notes filled two slates before she had finished unpacking.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

name: Tovid Ankarrel
description: An Archive-stewardship Zencadian on his first holiday in a century, walking the Nexaran Table with nothing scheduled for once.
backstory: Tovid served the Archive stewardship on Vigil for most of a long life, cataloguing Husk fragments and teaching the Remembrance to children. When the Archive granted him a rest term he booked passage through the Nexara Orbital Gate Station, arranged lodging and support in the South Arrival Ward, and told nobody at home what he planned to do with the time, because he had not decided. He arrived courteous, prepared and quietly astonished by the food.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

name: Iseth Vethrin
description: A Terran-line Kharai singer who crossed worlds for one booked night at the Grand Performance Hall and stayed for the morning after.
backstory: Iseth was born into the Vethrin clan-web on Terra and affirmed it as an adult, which her mother had not expected. She sang in Woven Compact listening-halls, recorded clan histories as music, and saved for three years to hear a Starian house on its own stage. She booked a seat at the Grand Performance Hall, a room off the Starfall Entertainment District, and a return berth. The performance ended. The city, inconveniently, had not.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Neon Nights

name: Aurelith Vaen
description: A Shape-attuned Elyri maker visiting Relstaris for a small artistic gathering, with a reserve pack they may never need and work they want to show.
backstory: Aurelith condensed at a Shape resonance site on Aethrys and was steadied through their first cycles by two wrights who became their kin. They grew living structure for a decade and drew what the structure could not yet become. A Current mentor arranged the crossing: a reserve, a booked room in the South Arrival Ward, a return route and an invitation to a gathering at the Grand Performance Hall's smallest room. They packed the drawings first.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

name: Devressa Kolm
description: A mixed-house Vexorath robotics technician with a practiced feel for machines and a habit of saying what the review hall is thinking.
backstory: Devressa was raised in Vexorath's Residential District by a technical-habitat household that argued about tolerances at dinner. She qualified as a robotics technician in the Fabrication Yards, where her machine-state sense made her the person called when a drone lied about its own fault codes. She spent her evenings in the Civic Systems Quarter review sessions and her nights wherever the Yards crews went after. She had opinions, and documentation for most of them.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light
Hair Color Pattern - Single Bold Streak

name: Lyvar Corsair
description: A Corsair teenager admitted to the Open Circle for light-work and to Rux's sword school on the same week, with no idea which he wants more.
backstory: Lyvar grew up on the Corsair Estate side of Helvyra, sixteen by offworld count, in a household that ran barge contracts and talked about Rux Corsair the way other families talked about weather. A family tutor taught him the first Illumination foundation because his affinity kept imprinting light on things he touched. The Open Circle accepted him. So, a day later, did the sword school across the Longreach. He had not yet told either about the other.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

name: Aldessa Ravello
description: A Ravello archive-house daughter starting supervised junior work under Maereth Ravello and, on other mornings, a beginner's court at Valcoro Academy.
backstory: Aldessa was raised in the Ravello Archive House, where the reading steps doubled as her childhood classroom and Eloria Ravello taught her to find a record before she could fly. She studied archiving and lineage history properly as a young adult and was cleared for supervised junior work in the Public Archive Atrium. Her family also enrolled her, over mild objection, in Valcoro Academy's beginner civic-defense course. She had never thrown a punch and did not intend to start.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

name: Tannikar Orvantis
description: An Orvantis teenager transferred from Korrvane's gyms to Valcoro Academy, with a public-hall striking record and a Weekly Bracket entry already filed.
backstory: Tannikar grew up in the Orvantis Quarter in Korrvane, seventeen by offworld count, in a household that measured a week by bouts won. He learned striking and footwork in the public halls rather than the family court, which Bostarix Orvantis recorded without comment. When his family moved him to Solvraxis he was admitted to Valcoro Academy as a transfer for assessment. He kept his Arena bracket entry anyway and told the Schedule Desk it was a formality.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

name: Brenara Yalven
description: A Yalven fabricator with a feel for stressed metal, a first piece leaving the Forgeworks under her name and a family that expects her to speak for it.
backstory: Brenara was born into House Yalven and raised on the Forgeworks production floors, where Fenra Yalven taught her to fit armor before she was tall enough to lift it. She qualified as a fabricator, practiced her material-stress affinity until the floor supervisors trusted it, and passed Nera Yalven's review once without a defect note. Torvane Yalven began sending her to the Grand Waypoint to speak on the house's behalf at small contract meetings. She preferred the floor.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

name: Kellvar Contair
description: A Contair repair technician taking his first independent commission at the Exchange, with a gate-yard assignment in Dustfall waiting after it.
backstory: Kellvar was raised in a technical-habitat household in Vexorath's Residential District, distant Contair kin who maintained systems rather than designed them. He trained as a repair technician in the Fabrication Yards, learned diagnostics under Drexan Contair's failure court, and earned a limited gate-maintenance authorization. Rezulith Contair's office cleared him for Dustfall's Lunar Gate Yard when its console faulted. First, the Exchange had a customer for him.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

name: Ravessa Nhalor
description: A Nhalor boarding-house host who fled Dravon labor housing with her family and now keeps the rooms in Dustfall's Residential Rows filled and fed.
backstory: Ravessa was born into the Nhalor guest-care tradition in Quilrath and came of age in Dravon-converted labor housing after the house lost its standing. She left with Avessa Nhalor's household on the Corridor route and helped rebuild the boarding rooms in the Residential Rows from stacked cargo shells. She ran the kitchen court, kept the ledger, and learned which arrivals meant trouble by the way they asked for a bed. Corren Nhalor taught the children; she fed them.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Frontier Ink

name: Essaran Quell
description: A no-House survey assistant walking Dustfall's beacon line with a practiced sense for routes and a room over the Long Shot they call temporary.
backstory: Essaran grew up in a remote settlement south of the Corridor, in a household with no House name and a long habit of walking out to see what the weather had moved. They trained as a survey assistant on the Dustfall Perimeter under Draxen Sol's volunteer patrol, until the beacon line read like a sentence. They rented an upper room at the Long Shot from Sennra Sol, took survey work from the job board, and told everyone it was for one season. That was four seasons ago.
traits: Practiced — Spatial line and route perception
Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Frontier Ink

name: Nevrik Pelorr
description: A Pelorr teenager learning repair at Hana's joining bench in the Residential Rows, with a Contair apprentice bay in Vexorath offered for the season.
backstory: Nevrik was born into the diminished fabrication house of Pelorr in Dustfall, fifteen by offworld count, and grew up under Velan Pelorr's frame decks with a wrench before a schoolbook. Hana Pelorr took him on at her joining bench as a supervised trainee, mending water lines and cargo-home fixtures for neighbors who paid in favors. A Contair placement notice from the Fabrication Yards came through Refit Row with his name on it. Hana said the customer on the step came first.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Frontier Ink

name: Haldra Cask
description: An Ignivex striker returning to the Crucible Yard after years away, with old training, a recorded loss in Korrvane and something left to settle.
backstory: Haldra grew up in a service household in the Hearth Rows of Ignivex and trained at the Crucible Yard as a young woman, learning to breathe through heat in Maeryn Volen's instruction ring. She fought once on the Korrvane Weekly Bracket, lost cleanly, and spent the following cycles working service jobs between the Cooling Steps and the Smoke Court. When Maeryn's ring posted a return appointment for former trainees, Haldra put her name on it before she could argue herself out.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

name: Giskella Aevon
description: An Aevon teenager cleared for her first supervised public flight over the Open-Sky Terrace, who already runs junior deliveries for Yadira's courier team.
backstory: Giskella grew up in the suspended terraces of the Aevon Quarter, fifteen by offworld count, in a household that timed her first flights and posted the results. Gisqon Aevon drilled her in lane etiquette at the Sky Etiquette School; Yadira Aevon let her carry junior capsules on the short routes when she stopped clipping markers. Her name went on the Open-Sky Terrace exhibition list for a supervised youth route. Elissara Aevon said she looked fast. Giskella took that badly.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

name: Corvenna Nivarek
description: A Nivarek archivist starting her first supervised assignment in the Record Court, with the family watching and the Standing system watching the family.
backstory: Corvenna was born inside the Nivarek Compound and raised among the red data columns, an academic household's child who learned to read a registry before a story. She qualified as an archivist, studied administration and law, and drilled the defense forms every Dravon-sphere house expects of its young. Thamur Nivarek assigned her to the Record Court under Ruvena's audit; Daruun did not attend the ceremony. Ferrik, out in the Gray Rings, sent a note that said only: be exact.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

name: Caivra Bellovari
description: A Bellovari host with a practiced voice, a first salon evening to run in the Market District and a habit of taking kitchen shifts in Relstaris to stay honest.
backstory: Caivra grew up on the performance steps of the Bellovari Market District, in a household where Galen Bellovari's exaggerations counted as bedtime stories. They trained in Liora Bellovari's pub, studied event planning under Alessa Bellovari's festival office, and practiced a vocal-resonance affinity until a room could be quieted without raising it. The family named them host for a salon evening at the Mirrorwater Gallery. They kept their Nexaran Table kitchen shift regardless.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Neon Nights

name: Dorren Caldris
description: A Caldris protective escort taking his first defensive posting on the Wallworks as Dravon's pressure on Ignivex tightens and the family holds the line.
backstory: Dorren was born into House Caldris in a caregiving household on the Wallworks, where his mother ran a breach-repair aid station and his father walked the firebreak gates. He trained as a protective escort under Orvak Caldris's patrol leads and practiced a kinetic-barrier affinity until it held under heat. Davor Caldris assigned him to the Patrol Staging Platforms; Maedra Caldris handed him the gate schedule herself. Tessan ran the walls above him.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light

name: Velkar Tesk
description: Kaldor Dravon's ward, not his blood: a Gray Rings dispatcher with a Keep upbringing, a Standing review pending and an assignment he means to improve.
backstory: Velkar came to the Ascendant Keep as a displaced child from the Ashrings and was raised there as Kaldor Dravon's ward, drilled beside Sorin and schooled in logistics under Vaelen's war-room staff. He carried no Dravon name and was never offered one. At majority he took a dispatcher's post in the Gray Rings works, assigned like anyone else, with a Standing review scheduled and a better posting dangling above it. He reported to the Keep on request and to the Works daily.
traits: Portrait Style - Dsar's Nexara — Civic Light
